children: Peabody Energy will present its strategic focus and recent business developments at the Jefferies Global Industrials Conference, highlighting a 2025 company snapshot of $3.9B revenue and $455M adjusted EBITDA.
Company will share slides at Jefferies conference (Exhibit 99.1) outlining strategy, operations and trends.
2025 results: $3.9B revenue, $455M adjusted EBITDA, ~5,400 employees and 0.71 TRIFR—continued safety improvements.
Balance sheet strength: zero net debt, >$900M liquidity, $351M restricted cash returned, revolver increased to $400M.
Growth drivers: Centurion NPV $2.1B, Centurion ramping to free cash flow with Q3 production improving (222k tons in Aug).
2026 guidance: targeted volumes and pricing by segment; capital expenditures ~$340M and ARO cash spend $65M for full year.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
